title: Memory Atom — Product Feature (v1)
description: Schema for specs/memory/product/<slug>.yaml (all 18 feature atoms). All 6 content fields are required per SPEC §C-1 (AC-C1-3). additionalProperties:false enforces D-5 atomicity — changelog/history/versions are structurally impossible.

feature_name.description: Display name for the feature (shown in <h1>). Optional: if absent the renderer uses the YAML filename slug. Template variable: feature_name.

feature_subtitle.description:
Subtitle shown in the

line (e.g. CLI surface string). Optional: renderer supplies a default from slug if absent. Template variable: feature_subtitle.

purpose.description:
Purpose prose (one or more paragraphs). Maps to
/

Propósito

. Template variable: purpose_paragraphs (renderer wraps each newline-separated paragraph in

tags).

flow_steps.description: Ordered list of usage flow steps. Each string maps to one <li> in the <ol class='flow'>. Template variable: flow_steps.

diagram.description: Optional Mermaid diagram source for the flow section. Renderer wraps in <pre class='mermaid'>. Template variable: flow_mermaid_optional.

typical_trigger.description: Single-paragraph description of the typical trigger for using this feature. Maps to <section id='trigger'>. Template variable: typical_trigger.

differential.description: Single-paragraph description of what differentiates this feature (why it exists). Maps to <section id='differential'>. Template variable: differential.

runtime_state.description: List of canonical runtime state locations touched by this feature. Each string maps to one <li> bullet. Maps to <section id='runtime-state'>. Template variable: runtime_state_bullets.

dependencies.description: List of dependencies (features, external tools, constraints). Each string maps to one <li> bullet. Maps to <section id='dependencies'>. Template variable: dependencies_bullets.
